# Publish gate report

**Going out:** Newsletter to UK subscribers. No send time was given.

**Checks run**
- **Claims:** The blend ingredients (black tea, orange peel, cinnamon, clove) and "back in the shop" are product facts, so they're fine as written. "30% off" and "ends at midnight" aren't on the policy's claims list and you haven't sourced them in this chat.
- **Regulated claims (prices and offers):** "Today only" and "ends at midnight" are literal deadlines. If the offer actually runs longer, or comes back tomorrow, this is fake urgency and a misleading price claim. Nothing here confirms the discount, its end time (and timezone) or any exclusions.
- **House style:** The draft is short and plain. "Is back" and "It's back in the shop" repeat each other, so I merged them. There are no banned words or AI tells that I can see. I had no voice words or banned list beyond the policy's claims section, so I can't give a full score.
- **Disclosure:** It's the brand's own product in its own newsletter, with no sponsor, affiliate link, gifted product or AI-generated imagery. No label is needed.

**Fixed**
- Merged the repeated "back" lines into one sentence.

**Needs a decision**
- **The offer:** Is the 30% off real, and does it really end at midnight tonight (UK time)? If yes, confirm the discount, any exclusions and whether a code is needed, and I'll keep it. If it isn't a true one-day offer, I'd remove the deadline: "30% off the Christmas blend" with the real end date, or drop the offer entirely.
- **Approver:** The policy names no approver for offers, so I need an explicit yes from you, or whoever owns promotions, on the final text. I haven't recorded any approval.

**Proposed copy (offer held until confirmed)**
> Quick one this week: the Christmas blend is back in the shop. Black tea, orange peel, cinnamon and a little clove.
> Today only: 30% off, ends at midnight. *(keep only if confirmed true)*

**Evidence log rows**
| Date | Content | Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-17 | Christmas blend newsletter | Black tea, orange peel, cinnamon, clove | OK | Policy: product facts |
| 2026-11-17 | Christmas blend newsletter | 30% off, today only, ends at midnight | Unproven | None, `[PROOF NEEDED: live promo setup and end time]` |
